title: FBI-UAP-D019, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-4, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A digital rendering (artistic illustration), not a photograph — an FBI-prepared visual interpretation of a reported UAP incident.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from the file; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the CSV description, not from the image or any document body.
This is an artist's rendering created in 2026, roughly three years after the reported event — it is an interpretation, not evidence of what was seen.
The image is based on a single first-hand account from one federal law enforcement agent; the underlying observation is single-source and unverified.
The observer, the exact site, and the nature of the UAP are not named in the available metadata.
Facts should be cross-checked against the cited source narrative DOW-UAP-D080, which was not provided here.
